title: Technical Project Manager – Packaging Machinery (f/m/d)
description:
Lead customer projects for packaging lines.

What you'll do
- Manage technical and commercial project delivery
- Coordinate design, procurement, assembly and commissioning
- Maintain risk and cost tracking and report to the sales director

What you bring
- 5+ years in project management in machine building
- Degree in engineering or industrial engineering
- Good English for supplier communication
